orig: わたしの知らない子どもたち
plotEn: In the charred ruins of 1945 Tokyo, during the final days and immediate aftermath of World War II, a young orphan 12-year-old daughter of musicians, to survive the harsh realities of the city's underworld, assumes the identity of a boy. Running parallel to her journey is that of her former teacher, who, haunted by guilt and struggling to survive herself, retraces the girl's footsteps in an attempt to uncover her fate.
